create_DeepEPLLPrepareAndFinalize: create a DeepEPLLPrepareAndFinalize instance with a deep_ep buffer, max_tokens_per_rank, and num_dispatchers for MoE prepare/finalize
run_prepare_async: run prepare_async on DeepEPLLPrepareAndFinalize to dispatch activation tensors to experts with async receive hook
run_finalize_async: run finalize_async on DeepEPLLPrepareAndFinalize to combine expert outputs using low-latency DeepEP kernels
test_maybe_roundup_layer_hidden_size: test maybe_roundup_layer_hidden_size to round up a hidden size to the closest supported value like 2048, 3072, or 4096
review_dequant_fp8: review dequant_fp8 to dequantize FP8 expert tensors back to FP32 using per-expert scales
